name: Client Lua loader: CoA interface pieces arrive after login and again after a /reload, with stored settings
contract: The server loads the CoARotation button and the CoACompanions frame into the client as Lua inside
SMSG_COA_PATCH_CHALLENGE_REQUIREMENT_TYPE (0x5BC). A client that never announces the hot-patch channel gets
them after the server's 30 second wait for that announcement. A /reload loses them; the
client announces its reloaded interface with CMSG_SET_ACTIONBAR_TOGGLES (0x2BF), and about 1.5 seconds later
the server sends them again. A setting saved with the COAUI<TAB>SAVE whisper is stored per character and
travels with the piece after the next login; a setting with characters outside the allowed set is dropped.
Expected: both pieces after login, at least both again after 0x2BF, the stored scale after a relog and no
trace of the rejected value. The client's rendering of the button and the frame is not exercised here.

steps.label: The CoARotation button arrives after login
The CoACompanions frame arrives after login
The reloaded interface reports its action bars
DISCRIMINATING: a reload brings both pieces back
The stored scale travels with the button after the relog
A setting with a quote is rejected
